Once the sperm and egg fuse together, the oocyte is said to have become activated, and the genetic material necessary for the formation of an embryo is supplied. In the context of email, "cc" stands for "carbon copy" and "bcc" stands for "blind carbon copy." 

A "cc" recipient receives a copy of the email in addition to the primary recipients listed in the "to" field. They are visible to all other recipients.

A "bcc" recipient also receives a copy of the email, but their address is hidden from all other recipients. It is used to keep the email address of the recipient private or to send a mass email without revealing the list of all recipients.
